literal: Of the exterior, limbs, all, what use, will do, [to the] body, of the interior, limb, love, to those who lack.
translation: Of what use are all the external limbs of the body to those who lack the essential internal limb of love?
modern: உள்ளுறுப்பாகிய அன்பு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு, உடம்பின் வெளி உறுப்புகள் எல்லாம் என்ன பயனைச் செய்யும்?
explanation: This couplet uses the metaphor of anatomy to explain the vital importance of love. The poet divides the human body into external limbs (புறத்துறுப்பு) like eyes, hands, and legs, and the internal limb (அகத்துறுப்பு), which is identified here as love (அன்பு). Just as a body cannot function or survive without its vital internal organs, a person's life is completely useless without the capacity for love. Therefore, having a fully functioning physical body is of no value if one lacks the core internal quality of love.
